tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: What the service translates, what files it accepts, limits, prices (yen, tax included), delivery times and how ordering and payment work.

tools.name: list_procedure_guides
tools.description: Guides to Japanese procedures that need translated English documents (e.g. tax deductions for family abroad, marriage registration, registering a birth abroad): what is required and what the translation must show, with government sources.

tools.name: quote_document
tools.description: Free price check: screens the file (format, pages, words, scanned pages) and returns the price, or why it can't be processed. Nothing is stored and nothing is charged.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Prepares an order for your user to approve and pay. Returns approvalUrl (give it to the user: they review the terms, consent and pay there; you cannot) and a private token for get_order_status. Nothing is charged until the user pays, and only when the certificate is issued.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: An order's status and the next step (e.g. waiting for the user's approval or for them to confirm a scan), the certificate number, and download links once completed.
